project_type: Expo SDK 54 custom-dev-build React Native (TypeScript) app with a local Expo native module (iOS Family Controls/ManagedSettings/DeviceActivity) for voluntary app-blocking; pure testable domain layer + AsyncStorage persistence + React Navigation native-stack UI. Local-only git repo on branch main.
language: TypeScript (strict). Native module is Swift (do NOT modify for these phases).
build_system: Expo SDK 54 (expo 54.0.38, react-native 0.81.5, react 19.1.0). Native deps pinned with '~' per the SDK 54 bundledNativeModules matrix. Config plugin at modules/goalie-focus/app.plugin.js injects iOS entitlements during `expo prebuild`. No native build is runnable here — verification ceiling for native is compile-only; do NOT attempt expo prebuild or xcodebuild in CI/this env.
test_framework: jest with preset 'jest-expo' (jest.config.js). Tests live in __tests__/*.test.ts(x). AsyncStorage is NOT auto-mocked: tests register require('@react-native-async-storage/async-storage/jest/async-storage-mock'). React screens tested with react-test-renderer via the harness in __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx.
build_command: npx tsc --noEmit  (type-check; package.json script: npm run typecheck)
test_command: npx jest  (single suite: npx jest <name>, e.g. npx jest focus-session)
verification_instructions: After each feature: 1) `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0; 2) `npm run lint` clean (eslint, flags unused imports); 3) `npx jest` relevant suite then full suite green; 4) `node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs` still valid. Baseline confirmed green before work: tsc clean, catalog valid, 75/75 jest tests passing. Native on-device behavior is NOT verifiable here (no device, no paid Apple account, no Family Controls entitlement, simulator cannot run Screen Time) — state this honestly, never fake it.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in from build. content/tracks.json is validated by scripts/validate-catalog.mjs. No prebuild artifacts should be committed by these phases.
environment_constraints: No remote, no push, work on main with plain local commits (never --amend/force, never --no-verify). Do NOT run `expo prebuild`/`pod install`/`xcodebuild`. Do NOT modify Swift under modules/goalie-focus/ios or ios-extensions. Treat the iOS focus feature as compile-only-verified. Use `npx expo install` to add native deps so the SDK 54 pin is resolved.
contribution_requirements: Match existing conventions: domain layer is pure TS (no react/react-native/AsyncStorage/Node-IO imports) and injects a clock for determinism (see src/domain/rewards Clock pattern); persistence lives ONLY in src/persistence/store.ts (single AsyncStorage key 'goalie.v1', one versioned document, structural guard that discards dishonest shapes); screens read state through ProgressionProvider and never import AsyncStorage; honest loading/empty/error states via src/ui/components/ScreenState; no fabricated data, no fake percentages, no imitation of other apps.
key_patterns: Honest focus availability via src/focus/availability.ts getFocusAvailability() -> {available:true} | {available:false, reason: FocusUnavailableReason}; reason copy in src/ui/focus/reasonText.ts REASON_TEXT. Native JS surface in src/focus/GoalieFocus.ts implements GoalieFocusApi (presentActivityPicker, getSelection, startFocusSession(durationSeconds) [schedules expiry BEFORE applying shields], stopFocusSession [idempotent emergency release], getActiveSession [app-group-persisted, authoritative for reconciliation]); FocusCancelledError = picker dismissed (clean no-op), FocusUnavailableError = cannot run here. Pure completion criterion: isLevelComplete (both lessons done AND mastery passed) in src/domain/progression. Completion EVENTS via deriveCompletionEvents(before, after, level, trackId) in src/domain/rewards (false->true edge). Certificate preview already exists: buildCertificatePreview in src/domain/certificates. catalogLookup.ts has findTrack/findLevel/findLesson. Duration bounds [60,86400] are enforced natively and must be mirrored in the JS domain.
directory_structure: src/domain/* pure domain (assessment, certificates, content, progression, rewards); src/focus/* typed native JS API + honest availability; src/persistence/store.ts the only AsyncStorage module; src/ui/{components,context,focus,navigation,screens} the React layer (12-route native-stack); modules/goalie-focus the local Expo native module (Swift ios/ + config plugin, do not modify); content/tracks.json catalog; scripts/validate-catalog.mjs content validator; __tests__ jest suites; docs/ios-focus-setup.md operator + honesty doc; .agents/tasks planning artifacts.
